summary: Design an AI-enabled CX roadmap, connect CRM and channel data, and define measurable journey outcomes. Explore the practical course.
lede: AI-driven customer journey orchestration coordinates customer signals, decisions, and channel workflows to shape interactions across the lifecycle. For CX leaders, CRM owners, marketing teams, and service managers, this course supports mapping priority journeys and planning a practical proof of concept. You’ll assess use cases and data needs, design cross-channel workflows and AI-assisted personalization, and choose measures while considering consent, governance, and human review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for connecting customer data, decisions, and service delivery across the customer lifecycle.
modules: AI-Enabled CX Roadmap and Proof of Concept
prerequisites: Working familiarity with CRM, marketing, or customer service processes is recommended. You should be able to discuss a customer journey or lifecycle challenge from your organization; coding experience is not required.
